title: Hummingbird ADR Proposal Contract v1
description: Static documentation of the fields Hummingbird expects when a participant offers material for a possible architecture or institutional decision. This schema is not a write API, does not allocate an ADR number, and does not imply admission, publication, or governance approval.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the proposed decision.

context.description: The architectural or institutional forces that make a decision necessary.

decision.description: The specific change or rule being proposed.

consequences.description: Expected benefits, costs, tradeoffs, failure modes, or new constraints.

alternatives_considered.description: Material alternatives considered, including keeping the current state where relevant.

affected_principles.description: Hummingbird principles, ADRs, charter sections, or governance boundaries affected by the proposed decision.
